A roll is made for each item on the table below, save for the raw mackerel, which is rolled twice.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1312360853723844609|date=3 October 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99298|archivedate=4 October 2020|quote=9 rolls: Boots Seaweed Gloves Mackerel Another mackerel Oyster Casket Cod Bass}} It is hence possible to catch multiple items simultaneously. Wearing a [[skills necklace]] with at least one charge while big net fishing will slightly increase the chance of finding a [[casket]].{{CiteTwitter|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1574717183888072705|author=Mod Ash|date=27 September 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99014|archivedate=20 December 2022|quote=Your chance of a casket from big net fishing [while wearing a charged skills necklace] is about 0.4 percentage points higher.}} If multiple types of fish are gained in the same catch, the player will receive a roll to obtain the [[heron]] pet for each type of fish that is caught.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://x.com/JagexAsh/status/1342431578836918272|date=25 December 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27964311|archivedate=5 August 2026|quote=[when big net fishing, if you get multiple fish in 1 catch does it roll for the pet once or for each fish caught?] (...)
